testsuite.name: org.thoughtcrime.securesms.jobs.InAppPaymentRecurringContextJobTest

testcase.name: Given a generic failed payment, when I run, then I expect properly updated state
Given an iDEAL IAP, when I getNextRunAttemptBackoff, then I expect one day
Given a failed payment on a keep-alive, when I run, then I expect failure proper iap state
Given no subscriber id, when I run, then I expect failure
Given 404 application error, when I run, then I expect a terminal iap state
Given user is unregistered, when I run then I expect failure
Given an inactive subscription, when I run, then I retry
Given no redemption data, when I run, then I expect failure
Test happy path for subscription redemption
Given 403 application error, when I run, then I expect a terminal iap state
Given getActiveSubscription app-level error, when I run, then I expect failure
Given a CREATED IAP, when I onAdded, then I expect PENDING
Given an inactive subscription with a charge failure, when I run, then I update state and fail
Given an IAP without an error, when I onFailure, then I set error and move to end state
Given END state, when I run, then I expect failure
Given redemption started, when I run, then I expect failure
Given a SEPA IAP, when I getNextRunAttemptBackoff, then I expect one day
Given 409 application error, when I run, then I expect a terminal iap state
Given user has donor entitlement already, when I run, then I do not expect receipt request
Given user has backup entitlement already, when I run, then I do not expect receipt request
Given a charge failure, when I run, then I expect properly updated state
Given a canceled subscription with a charge failure for keep-alive, when I run, then I update state and fail
Given getActiveSubscription execution error, when I run, then I expect retry
Given no available subscription, when I run, then I expect retry
Given redeemed, when I run, then I expect failure
Given 400 application error, when I run, then I expect a terminal iap state
Given 402 application error, when I run, then I expect a retry
Given non-recurring IAP, when I run, then I expect failure
Given 204 application error, when I run, then I expect a retry
